678-5865-6797.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn
678-5865-6797.description:
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.
When Flamecache Gecko enters, it triggers, adding {B}{R}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Flamecache Gecko.
When Flamecache Gecko dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Flamecache Gecko from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Repeat.

1251-2023-4518-6723.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

985-1169-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

483-678-5670--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
483-678-5670--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4247-4275-5003-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Elves that do not have summoning sickness.
4247-4275-5003-7892.description:
Activate at least four Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding at least four in any combination of {G} and/or {U}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Thranduil.
When Thranduil dies, Nim Deathmantle and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Thranduil from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Elves and Nobles.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

483-1981-2415-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2741-5231.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2741-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

2043-4715-4893-7824.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating two token copies of Prized Statue that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4089-6913.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4089-6913.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Chameleon and Glasspool Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4089-6913.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1619-2511-4605-5542-6150.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6150.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Tomb of Horrors Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Tomb of Horrors Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tomb of Horrors Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6150.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1251-1368-1563-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1251-1368-1563-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1061-7631.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} the first turn, plus {2}{U}{U} each turn
1061-7631.easyPrerequisites: You control nine or more permanents and/or have the city's blessing.
1061-7631.description:
Cast Echocasting Symposium by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator and exiling Echocasting Symposium.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Timestream Navigators will give you the city's blessing.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
Repeat from step 3.

3059-6093-7408.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}. It'll enter with power equal to half the highest life total among your opponents, rounded up.
When Malignus enters, Champion of the Path triggers, causing Malignus to deal damage equal to its power doubled to each opponent due to Twinflame Tyrant.
3059-6093-7408.notes: Malignus also makes the damage unpreventable due to its static effect. This combo should result in each opponent losing the game except in niche circumstances.

3693-5660-7388.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Rocksteady triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4613-5310-5477-5627-7296.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
4613-5310-5477-5627-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-5310-5477-5627-7296.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

2539-3094-4659-6968-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2539-3094-4659-6968-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1692-3000-7150.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping two creatures you control, copying the Helm of the Host trigger.
Resolve the copy of the Helm of the Host trigger, creating a token copy of Kirol that isn't legendary and 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Holding priority, activate the Kirol token by tapping two creatures you control, copying the Helm of the Host trigger.
Repeat from step 3.

1409-5421-6751.description:
Activate Redcap Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Redcap Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Redcap Thief.
Resolve both Redcap Thief triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

803-1669-2366-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
803-1669-2366-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-3836-5078-6608.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

454-1978-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Forests.
454-1978-5709.description:
Cause Rofellos to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Rofellos.
Repeat from step 2.

38-2173-4063-5220.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2034-4679-4730-6023.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sparring Mummy.
When the Sparring Mummy token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Sparring Mummy token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

5412-5531-6621-6763.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
5412-5531-6621-6763.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.

759-1247-5259-5963-6549.description:
Cast Rude Awakening by paying {4}{G}, causing all lands you control to become creatures until end of turn.
Activate Marvin using Grove of the Burnwillows' second ability by tapping it, adding {R} or {G} and causing each opponent to lose 1 life due to Tainted Remedy.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3490-4268-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
2034-3490-4268-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Kor Celebrant indestructible.
2034-3490-4268-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

575-4319-5315-5441.notablePrerequisites: Skirk Alarmist does not have summoning sickness.
575-4319-5315-5441.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Granite Witness.
When Granite Witness dies, Yedora triggers, returning Granite Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Activate Granite Witness by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Granite Witness face-up.
Granite Witness triggers, untapping Skirk Alarmist.
Repeat.

2301-4050-6115.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ozox, adding {1}.
When Ozox dies, it and Abzan Ascendancy trigger.
Resolve the Ozox trigger, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Jumblebones and the other creature token, adding {1}{B}.
When Jumblebones dies, it triggers, returning Ozox from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

2097-4871-6074.description:
During your upkeep, activate Nim Devourer by paying {B}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then sacrificing it.
When Nim Devourer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

2-3129-5637.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Kozilek's Unsealing's first ability triggers, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

4881-5011-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cavalier of Night.
When Cavalier of Night dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, it triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Activated Sleeper.
When Activated Sleeper dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, it triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 4, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4.

1479-3257-3875.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3257-3875.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Tireless Provisioner, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

6-2825-4028.notablePrerequisites: Zhur-Taa Druid and Elite Arcanist do not have summoning sickness.
6-2825-4028.description:
Activate Zhur-Taa Druid by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {1} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vitalize without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
